name: Yareta
desc: A dense, cushion-forming evergreen of the high Andes that grows only a centimetre or so a year. Local people burn it for fuel, which is hard for it to withstand.
about: Yareta or llareta (in Spanish), known scientifically as Azorella compacta, is a velvety, chartreuse cushion plant in the family Apiaceae which is native to South America.
